overloadPatches.semanticRole: Start a new process on the same machine, running the given process method with an allocated stack size and optional name/parameters, and return its process number.

jointConstraints.rule: If any param is passed to the process method, name cannot be omitted; it must be explicitly provided so the parameter list can be positionally reached.

interactionNotes.note: When the trailing '*' is specified, 4D first checks whether a process named `name` is already running; if so, no new process is created and the process number of the already-running process is returned instead.

constraints: Standard Object/Collection parameters passed in param are passed by copy (a duplicate is created in the destination process); pass a shared object/collection instead to get pass-by-reference semantics.

Pointers to variables (especially local/process variables) are not recommended as param values since the pointed-to variable may no longer exist when the process method accesses it; pointers to tables/fields are fine.
Arrays cannot be passed as parameters to the new process method.
